Name: Master volume
Description: Apply the master mixer gain from 0 to 100 percent. Zero requests silence without stopping playback. The live value is the target gain. Native pause and track ducking continue to apply.
RestoreBehavior: Applied once. Later game settings or fades may replace it. Apply game audio settings to restore the four loaded levels; disconnect and Disable all effects leave one-time mix changes applied.

Evidence.Finding: Normal app lifecycle serializes init/update/shutdown; audio workers hold the global Sound CS while updating envelopes. Game-thread commands lock, validate fresh bus identities and apply one-millisecond native gain transitions.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA, original-byte verification and isolated tests; live behavior pending
